de: An English fleet defeats a French fleet in the battle of Sandwich, cutting off Prince Louis of France from supplies and diminishing his hopes to gain the English throne during the First Barons' War.

de: Following the French defeat in the battle of Lincoln, Prince Louis of France ratifies the treaty of Lambeth under which he abandons all claims to the English throne and returns to France in exchange of an indemnity payment.

dz: 《森林宪章》由国王亨利三世在伦敦圣保禄大教堂受封,由威廉·马歇尔(William Marshall, 1st Earl of Pembroke)摄政,重新确立自由人进入被征服者威廉及其继承人侵蚀的皇家森林的权利.
de: The Charter of the Forest is sealed at St Paul's Cathedral, London by King Henry III, acting under the regency of William Marshall, 1st Earl of Pembroke which re-establishes for free men rights of access to the royal forest that had been eroded by William the Conqueror and his heirs.
